openings.claim: Bind requests to immutable video/caption snapshots; show pair identity and request order through download.
openings.discriminator: Reversed completions preserve intended selection and input hashes.
openings.fit: uncertain; retain delivered pair and original wording
openings.probe: Private staging: both editors, rapid edits, replacement cut, delivered-version retrieval.
openings.uncertainty: Budget feasibility and editors' recognition; hashes alone cannot prove intent.

openings.claim: Separate render waiting from identification and inspection delay.
openings.probe: Review events and time single/repeated-edit walkthroughs; leave unidentified historical pairs unresolved.
openings.uncertainty: Festival demand and 30-session performance remain unestablished.

openings.claim: Immediately overlay captions on a frozen private video pair; render approved pairs into required embedded-caption format.
openings.discriminator: Faster inspection only if waiting dominates and overlay agrees with embedded playback.
openings.probe: Compare cue boundaries, timing/layout and editor correction times; reuse private playback within four engineer-days, one editor-day, 80 total weekly processing hours or retain incumbent.
openings.uncertainty: Playback reuse and inspection fidelity unproven.

openings.claim: Distinguish wrong input capture from unexpected history selection.
openings.discriminator: First divergence before worker input versus at download; both or neither possible.
openings.probe: Trace editor-confirmed hashes at request, worker, completion and download under reversed completion order.
openings.uncertainty: Independent intent confirmation and staging generalizability.

decision: Prioritize bounded private diagnostics and identity prototype; gate overlay on waiting and fidelity evidence. Share stipulated labor/compute limits across probes. Synthetic baseline 20/30 versus required 27/30; nine successful single-correction sessions limit generalization. No computing shortage established.
